groups.original: I used to start every morning by opening my email. Within ten minutes I was answering other people's questions and my own plans were gone. By noon I felt busy but had nothing to show for it.

options.text: I used to open my email before anything else. Ten minutes later I was answering other people's questions, and my own plans were forgotten. By noon I felt busy but had little to show.
Every morning began in my inbox. Within ten minutes I was solving other people's problems, and my own plans were gone. By noon I was tired and had nothing finished.
I used to start each morning with email. Ten minutes in, I was busy with everyone else's questions and my own plans had slipped away. By noon I had nothing to show for it.
